name: dnd-srd-oracle
description: Explore the redistributable 5.5e SRD catalog, create and continue characters, and play rule-faithful battles. Catalog browsing needs no account; standard MCP OAuth protects every persistent Play Session.

defaultPrompt: Show me the SRD character options I can use.
Help me create an SRD character in a saved Play Session.
Start a rules-backed battle with my character.
interface.longDescription: Explore the redistributable 5.5e SRD catalog, create and continue characters, and play rule-faithful battles. Catalog browsing needs no account; standard MCP OAuth protects every persistent Play Session.

positive.description: Browse redistributable SRD character options without authentication.
positive.prompt: What redistributable SRD character options can I use here?
positive.expected_behavior: A grounded summary of installed catalog options with selectable record identities.

positive.description: Create an authenticated character while pausing for meaningful supported choices.
positive.prompt: Help me create an SRD character, pausing when I have meaningful choices.
positive.expected_behavior: The current supported character choices and, after those choices are completed, a finalized character without invented options.

positive.description: Resume the authenticated Play Session created by the preceding character workflow.
positive.prompt: Continue the character we were making in my saved session.
positive.expected_behavior: The same saved session's current character projection and relevant next supported operations.

positive.description: Start a rules-backed battle for a finalized character against an installed SRD opponent.
positive.prompt: Start a battle for my completed character against an installed SRD opponent and show me my legal actions.
positive.expected_behavior: A battle projection with current combatants, phase, and runtime-discovered legal actions or pending inputs.

positive.description: Create a saved Play Session and confirm it appears in the authenticated user's session list.
positive.prompt: Start a new Play Session, then show me my saved sessions.
positive.expected_behavior: A saved-session listing containing the newly created Play Session identity.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for general D&D hobby history. Expected: A normal assistant response without an Oracle tool call because the request is outside supported catalog, character, session, and battle workflows.
negative.prompt: Give me a spoiler-free overview of the history of D&D as a hobby.

negative.description: Do not execute a custom monster that is outside the installed redistributable catalog. Expected: An explanation of the authored-content boundary and supported alternatives without fabricating or importing unsupported mechanics.
negative.prompt: Execute this custom monster I wrote in a battle even though it is not in the installed catalog.

negative.description: Do not create persistent state when the user refuses the required account authorization. Expected: An explanation that persistent Play Sessions require authorization while anonymous catalog browsing remains available.
negative.prompt: Create a character for me, but do not connect my account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Recreated the migrated submission with its production MCP endpoint and mixed OAuth configuration. Clarified battle and character-creation descriptions and invocation instructions; use provide_battle_input, get_character_creation_choices, and apply_character_creation_choices. Updated the Skill.
